title: Ban cap nhat v1.2.5 - Fix triet de loi treo View/Scrcpy & Them nut Bat/Tat View tiet kiem CPU
releaseNotes:
- Them nut '📱 Tat View (Tiet kiem CPU)' giup tat toan bo Scrcpy, ha CPU ve 0% ma tool van tu dong chay 100% qua ADB
- Toi uu Scrcpy xuong 480p @ 20 FPS, bo render software giup khong con ngốn 100% CPU khi chay nhieu may
- Bo SetFocus dong bo xuyen tien trinh va go bo Timer 16ms chay ngam 24/7 tren OverlayWindow
- Luu bo nho dem chi so thiet bi (Index cache) loai bo hoan toan cac lenh Invoke dong bo gay deadlock UI thread
